body.explanation: So each orbital holds at most two electrons with opposite spins.

title: Heisenberg's uncertainty principle means:
subject: subj:chem1

body.stem: Heisenberg's uncertainty principle means:
options: Electrons move on fixed orbits whose radius is known exactly
Position and momentum cannot both be known precisely
body.explanation: So we speak of the probability of presence (orbitals).

body.explanation: Many-electron atoms need quantum mechanics.

title: Hund's rule states that:
subject: subj:chem1

body.stem: Hund's rule states that:
options: Orbitals fill in order of n + l
In a subshell, electrons occupy separate orbitals with parallel spins before pairing
Two electrons of the same atom cannot share the same four quantum numbers
body.explanation: Aufbau gives the order of filling; Pauli limits two per orbital.
